name: jack press
description: A jumping jack combined with an overhead press. It raises your heart rate and works the shoulders and legs together.
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Jump your feet out wide as you press the dumbbells overhead.
Lock out the arms without arching your back.
Jump your feet together as you lower the weights to your shoulders.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set.
